news.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
news.summary: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

news.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
news.summary: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

news.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
news.summary: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.
